generation_process: Read the official announcement and agent taskbook to identify three scope levels and six agent tasks.
Read the site package (allowed design space, enums, ranges, source registry) to lock editable layers and boundary constraints.
Generate geometry layers (site boundary, key areas, land use, buildings, roads, green/public space, phasing) within the allowed design space.
Recalculate all area metrics in EPSG:4548 from the submitted GeoJSON.
Generate figures, A3/A0 drawings, and HTML using the same metrics source.
Run deterministic validation, spatial review, visual packaging check, and professional evidence review.
human_review: All geometry is provisional and must be recalculated when official boundary polygons are supplied.
This is a conceptual design proposal for the open call, not an official government document.
limitations: No official SITE_BOUNDARY or KEY_AREA polygon was available; provisional geometry was used.
No approved regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, or municipal engineering data were available.
AI-generated assets were reviewed for clearance but do not constitute legal copyright proof.
